evaluations.note: 19 since the sheared cells of common/data/elastic.tadahdb were corrected (2026-09-30). BFGS's line search reaches the upper bound RCUT2B = 6 at eval 9 and re-evaluates it at eval 10, whose loss comes out at the rounding level below eval 9's (the ~1e-13 relative re-evaluation noise of the warm-started lattice relaxation) and becomes the best (1.004806e-01); the gradient there evaluates 5.999998 and 5.999996 (evals 11-12), the line search returns to 6 at eval 13, and the stagnation window fires there: 13 + 3 + 3 = 19. Before the correction the window fired at eval 12 (12 + 3 + 3 = 18) since the in-house finite-difference stencil stays inside the OPTIM box (one-sided within a step of a bound; owner decision 2026-09-29, C4): the central stencil had evaluated 6.000002 at eval 11, outside the box [4, 6], which came out lower, became the best and reset the window (14 + 3 + 3 = 20). Earlier: lowered 23 -> 20 with AFTER_STAGNATION 4 -> 3 when common/lammps/Ecoh.in switched to exact captures. RESTART RANDOM draws its restart points from std::random_device, so evals 14-19 differ from run to run; nothing pinned here depends on them: the best comes from the deterministic first launch (evals 1-13), and every restart stops after exactly 3 evals because no start in [4, 6] beats the incumbent at the upper bound (6 repeated runs on 2026-09-30: identical count, status, best loss and parameters).
